performance.verdict: Spend went dark Aug 6; 14 days of zero is the only real problem.

findings.text: Meta spend has been $0 for 14 consecutive days (Aug 6–19); all 43 leads and $1,024 in 28-day spend came before the blackout.
3-day lead signal (Aug 4–5: 4+4=8 leads, $144.92 spend) vs prior 3 (Aug 1–3: 1+3+1=5 leads, $224.38 spend) shows CPL was improving pre-blackout — the pause killed a working engine.
GHL shows only 31 contacts vs 43 leads and 0 opportunities created — 12-lead gap signals an intake leak, not an ads problem; this predates the blackout.
GBP actions dropped 75% WoW and ig_reach hit -100% (0 reach last 7d vs 1,205 prior 28d); organic visibility collapsing alongside paid dark compounds pipeline drought.
Search clicks fell -42.98% WoW (recent low of 0 on Aug 18–19 in series) while GA4 sessions rose +47.45% — directional conflict suggests GA4 double-count property issue, not real traffic growth.

suggestions.text: Immediately diagnose and restore Meta spend; account has been dark 14 days — identify billing, policy, or access block causing $0 spend.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 since Aug 6 — 14 full days of zero delivery, confirmed in the daily series. Prior to the blackout, the account was producing leads at a CPL of ~$18 in the Aug 4–5 window, below the 28-day average of $23.82. Hamza/Hamdan must diagnose the root cause today (billing hold, ad account disabled, policy flag, or access issue) and restore delivery at the last active daily budget of ~$70–75/day. Success is confirmed when Meta spend resumes above $50/day within 48 hours (by Aug 22).

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 12 leads missing from pipeline (43 leads, 31 contacts, 0 opps) — fix form-to-GHL webhook or contact deduplication causing the gap.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows only 31 contacts against 43 leads recorded in Meta over the 28-day window, and 0 opportunities have been created. This is an intake leak, not an ads problem — leads are arriving but not entering the pipeline for Andrew to work. The fix is to audit the instant-form-to-GHL webhook connection and check for duplicate suppression or failed syncs dropping records. Success is confirmed when contacts in GHL match within 5% of Meta leads reported, validated by Aug 25.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: actions dropped 75% WoW and ig_reach is at 0 — re-check Aug 23 to determine if listing issue or organic decay after paid went dark.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 75% week-over-week and Instagram reach dropped to 0 over the last 7 days. This may be organic decay coinciding with the paid blackout, or an independent listing or access issue. No action is warranted until Meta spend is restored and we can separate paid halo from true organic performance. Re-check on Aug 23 — if GBP actions remain below 5/day after Meta resumes, escalate to a listing audit.
